steps.text: Stand with your arms by your sides.
Raise both arms forward with your elbows straight and your thumbs up.
Stop at shoulder height and hold for one second.

mistakes.label: back_arch
mistakes.wrong: your lower back bent backwards as your arms went up
mistakes.right: Keep your back still; do not lean backwards as your arms go up.

mistakes.label: swinging
mistakes.wrong: you swung your arms up quickly instead of lifting slowly
mistakes.right: Lift slowly and pause at the top instead of swinging.
